# 单请求峰值连接实测（本地副本库 topems_conn_bench，2026-11-12）
# 采样：psql \watch 0.01s；仅统计 backend_type='client backend'，排除 parallel worker 与采样自身
# 采样 SQL：
select clock_timestamp(), count(*), count(*) filter (where state='active'), count(*) filter (where state like 'idle in transaction%') from pg_stat_activity where datname='topems_conn_bench' and pid<>pg_backend_pid() and backend_type='client backend';
